name: mandaloom
description: Read and populate private recursive Mandala grids, and edit objective progress fields through your Mandaloom account.

interface.longDescription: Connect your private Mandaloom workspace. Find objectives, explore nested grids, create roots and supporting objectives, populate empty grid cells in a batch, and edit text fields or statuses. Sign in with your existing account and grant read-only or editing access. Revision checks protect existing work; no delete or move tools are included.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read my Mandaloom workspace and help me populate a grid.
